name: nilLen_lt
source: private theorem nilLen_lt {A M : Type} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
(f : Module.End A M) (hf : IsNilpotent f) (k : ℕ) (hk : f ^ k ≠ 0) :
have key : ∀ j, LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + j)) = LinearMap.range (f ^ k) := by
| succ j ih => rw [← add_assoc, nilLen_range_succ, ih, ← nilLen_range_succ, h]
rw [pow_add, hn, mul_zero, LinearMap.range_zero] at hkn
show: For a nilpotent endomorphism f of a module over a commutative ring, if fᵏ is nonzero then the image of f to the power k+1 is properly contained in the image of fᵏ.
strategy: The images decrease under iteration. Equality at one step would propagate to all later powers, including one whose image is zero.

steps.claim: Let $I_j=f^j M$. To prove $I_{k+1}\subsetneq I_k$, the inclusions of successive images give $I_{k+1}\subseteq I_k$, while nilpotence and $f^k\ne0$ exclude equality.

children.claim: Since $f^{k+1}=f^k\circ f$, every vector in $I_{k+1}$ already belongs to $I_k$.
If $I_{k+1}=I_k$, applying $f$ repeatedly gives $I_{k+j}=I_k$ for all $j$. Nilpotence makes one of these later images zero, which would force $f^k=0$.
Assume $I_{k+1}=I_k$ and choose $n$ with $f^n=0$ from nilpotence. A contradiction will follow if the stable image equals $I_{k+n}$.
children.snippet:
· intro h
    apply hk
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hf

children.claim: For every $j\ge0$, one has $I_{k+j}=I_k$ because $I_{r+1}=f(I_r)$ propagates the assumed equality of successive images.
children.snippet:
have key : ∀ j, LinearMap.range (f ^ (k + j)) = LinearMap.range (f ^ k) := by
      intro j

children.claim: Induction on $j$ compares the images after $j$ additional iterations of $f$ with the image at $k$.
When $j=0$, the two images coincide because $k+0=k$.
If $I_{k+j}=I_k$, then $I_{k+j+1}=f(I_{k+j})=f(I_k)=I_{k+1}=I_k$, using the assumed equality at $k$.
children.snippet: | succ j ih => rw [← add_assoc, nilLen_range_succ, ih, ← nilLen_range_succ, h]

children.claim: At $j=n$ we have $I_k=I_{k+n}=0$ since $f^{k+n}=f^k f^n=0$. A linear map with zero image is zero, contrary to $f^k\ne0$.
children.snippet:
have hkn := key n
    rw [pow_add, hn, mul_zero, LinearMap.range_zero] at hkn
    exact LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp hkn.symm

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
